## Run it locally

Needs Node 24+ and pnpm 12. The wallet's WASM build is committed, so Rust isn't needed.

```bash
pnpm install
```

```bash
pnpm --filter @mitoshi/web dev
```

That serves `localhost:3300` on Zcash **testnet** through the deployed relay (the app tints itself vermilion so test
money never passes for real money). `pnpm --filter @mitoshi/web dev:main` serves mainnet on port 3301. Private wallets
are funded on mainnet only.

## Checks

```bash
pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
```

| Package | Tests | What they cover |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `packages/engine` | 22 | Denominations, rest rules, scheduler, registry and `positionWallet`, leak meter, keys |
| `packages/rails` | 7 | 1Click quote requests and the ed25519 signature check |
| `packages/venues` | 7 | Polymarket Perps signing (4) and Solana transactions (3) |

CI runs Biome, the type checks, these tests and a full build on Node 24 for every push to `main` and every pull request.

## Deploy

| What | Command |
| --- | --- |
| App and relay (Cloudflare) | `pnpm --filter @mitoshi/web-worker run deploy` |
| Gateway (Vercel) | `pnpm --filter @mitoshi/gateway run deploy` |
| This site (Cloudflare) | `pnpm --filter @mitoshi/docs run deploy` |
| Rebuild the wallet WASM | `pnpm --filter @mitoshi/zwallet build:wasm` (Rust, LLVM clang, the wasi-libc sysroot) |

The gateway's secrets (its OHTTP seed, the relay token, NEAR's partner key, Polymarket's builder credentials) are set on
the host, never in the repository.
